page_title: ESP 1-0 OSA | Espanyol v Osasuna 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Sesma and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+3' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

90+2' A nice lofted cross finds Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
87' Miguel Sesma shows a yellow card to Iker Benito (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
84' Today's match ends for Javi Puado who will be replaced by Miguel Rubio (Espanyol).
84' Javi Puado (Espanyol) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
84' Alessio Lisci has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iker Benito replacing Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
84' Alessio Lisci has decided to make a change. Kike Barja (Osasuna) replaces Jon Moncayola.
84' The attendance for today's match is 29780.
82' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.

80' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Marko Dmitrovic, who tips the ball around the post.
79' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) and he is replaced by Luca Koleosho.
79' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Pere Milla (Espanyol) will be replaced by Ramon Terrats.
75' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
74' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Victor Munoz is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
71' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Victor Munoz (Osasuna). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
68' Javi Puado (Espanyol) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
66' Alessio Lisci has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) replacing Moi Gomez.
66' Here is a change. Kike Garcia is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol).
66' The substitution is prepared. Urko Gonzalez joins the action as a substitute, replacing Exposito (Espanyol).
66' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle and it's Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
61' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
60' Miguel Sesma couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Juan Cruz (Osasuna) and blew his whistle.
59' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Sesma had an easy-decision to make.
56' Rough tackle by Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) makes a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.
52' 1 - 0 Goal! Carlos Romero (Espanyol) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
52' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
50' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:5.
49' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
48' The linesman makes the right call and Espanyol will have a corner.
47' Miguel Sesma blows for a foul after Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Osasuna was in an offside position.
45+2' Espanyol fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Kike Garcia (Espanyol) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Espanyol.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
44' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Good work from Osasuna as they win a corner.
41' Handball by Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
39' The referee blows his whistle as Lucas Torro (Osasuna) was too aggressive in his challenge.
38' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) commits a foul after dangerous play.
32' A cooling break is underway.
30' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
29' Javi Puado (Espanyol) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar.
27' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Pol Lozano (Espanyol) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
24' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Exposito (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Miguel Sesma didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

21' That was a nice football moment. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Marko Dmitrovic guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
20' The ball possession is 61:39.
18' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

16' What a chance that is! Javi Puado (Espanyol) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
14' Pere Milla (Espanyol) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Sergio Herrera gets down to his right to keep it out.
14' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Sergio Herrera. What a save!
12' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Sesma has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
8' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) makes a strong challenge and Miguel Sesma blows for a foul.
7' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Kike Garcia (Espanyol) offside.
6' Exposito (Espanyol) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Osasuna.
4' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) commits a rough foul. Miguel Sesma stops the game and makes a call.
3' The game is interrupted. Lucas Torro (Osasuna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
